context.detail: 33 invoice(s) were placed in this filing period on their issue date because no operation date is recorded on them: ALQ-01, ALQ-02, ALQ-03, ALQ-04, ALQ-05 and 28 more. LIVA art. 75.Uno binds the devengo to the date the entrega or prestacion took place, and an invoice may lawfully be issued in a later period than the one its operation belongs to, so this placement is a substitution, not a legal determination
context.remedy: Record the fecha de operacion on each invoice named so its period is determined by the art. 75 devengo date rather than inferred from the issue date

notices.message: Some invoices have no date for when the operation took place, so their issue date chose the period.

context.detail: 45 ledger row(s) were placed in this period on their bank movement date because no operation date is recorded: 05d48cf379fb, 07851b517799, 1ba8109eaf33 and 42 more. LIVA art. 75 fixes the devengo by the operation, not the collection, so a sale near a period end can belong to the previous one
context.remedy: Record the operation date on each row. For a pago anticipado, art. 75.Dos dates the amount received at its collection, so record the collection date

notices.message: Some ledger rows have no operation date, so their bank date chose the IVA period. IVA falls due when the operation takes place, not when the money moves.
